blocks.html: The "Special Tribeca Mixed Use District" is a Special Purpose District designated by the letters "TMU" in which special regulations set forth in Article XI, Chapter 1, apply. The Special Tribeca Mixed Use District and its regulations supplement or supersede those of the districts on which it is superimposed.
